Short answers to help you choose a ritual and get ready for your visit.
How do I choose the right ritual?

Choose by time, by the kind of experience, and by whether you want a ritual for the head or for the feet. Both come in relaxation, beauty care, deep care, a men's ritual and an experience for two. If you are unsure, ask the salon before booking.
How is HEAD SPA 30 related to Salón 30?

HEAD SPA 30 is the Head Spa concept of the Salón 30 hair salon and operates in its rooms at Mostná 30 in Nitra. The same address and the same team. Hairdressing, colouring, colour work and the trichology examination are at www.salon30.sk; the Head Spa rituals have their own price list here on this page.
Do I have to wash my hair before the visit?
There is no need, because washing and care are part of the ritual. If your scalp has specific needs, mention them during the consultation.
Do you have foot rituals too?

Yes. The offering has two equal halves: seventeen rituals for the head and seventeen for the feet, both in five categories (classic, men's, children's, for two and luxury). They run 40 to 120 minutes and prices start at €45. The foot rituals take place in the same quiet room and you lie the same way as for Head Spa.
Is Head Spa suitable for men too?
Yes. The offering includes a separate men's category with 45-, 60-, 90- and 120-minute rituals.
Can the two of us come together?
Yes. There are two shared rituals for 2 people: the Shared Head Spa ritual and the Shared ritual under the stars.
Is blow drying included in the rituals?
For the Head Spa rituals, the final blow dry or professional blow dry is listed directly in what that particular service involves.

Tap Book on the ritual card or at the top of the page. Our online booking through Booqme opens, where you choose the ritual, the day and the time yourself. If you are unsure what to choose, call us and we will help.
How long does a ritual take and what does it cost?

The shortest ritual is 40 minutes and costs €45; the longest are the two-hour premium rituals at €149. Rituals for two run 60 to 90 minutes and the price of €115 to €249 covers both people. Each ritual has its exact time and price in the price list.
Can Head Spa be given as a gift?

Yes. You buy the gift card online by card through Booqme and it arrives by e-mail straight away with a code the recipient enters when booking. You can give an amount or a specific ritual, or order the card by e-mail and collect it at the salon.
How should I prepare for the visit?

Just arrive a few minutes early. You do not have to wash your hair, but ideally without much styling product and natural, without hairpieces, so we can reach the scalp directly. For the cosmetic ritual it is better to come without make-up.
Is Head Spa suitable for coloured or extended hair?

Coloured hair is usually not a problem. If you coloured it in the last 48 hours, or you have hair extensions, dreadlocks or braids, tell us when booking. Some steps of the ritual need direct access to the scalp, so we will adapt them.
The ritual takes place lying on your back, in a position that is comfortable for you. If you are pregnant, tell us when booking, and with a high-risk pregnancy speak to your doctor first.
How often should I come for Head Spa?

As a break, whenever you need it. If you want a visible effect on the scalp, regularity makes sense, for example once every three to four weeks. At the consultation we will suggest a rhythm based on the condition of your scalp.
What should I wear and bring?

Nothing special. Comfortable clothes; during the ritual you lie on your back. The towel, the products and the blow dry are part of the ritual. Leave your phone in your bag, at least for those few dozen minutes.
Is it suitable for a sensitive scalp?
Tell us about sensitivity, dandruff or allergies during the consultation at the start. We adapt the pressure of the massage, the water temperature and the products to what your skin can take.
Can I come with a child?
Yes. There is a Children's fruit Head Spa, a 50-minute ritual made for children. If you want to come together, book slots next to each other or call us and we will arrange it.
